name: Laura Gordon
bio: Laura Gordon is an Australian actress. She was nominated for the 2020 AACTA Award for Best Actress in a Leading Role for her role in Undertow (2018). Other major roles include films Em 4 Jay (2008)[3] and Face to Face (2011) and TV shows Winners & Losers, Hunters and Secret City: Under the Eagle. Gordon was a member of the Red Stitch Theatre actors' co-operative.
